text: I think you'll really enjoy this Sesame Pea Pods recipe, and it's a great fit for your dietary needs. As a gluten-free option, it's a safe choice for you. The ingredients are also relatively quick to prepare, which fits within your 60-minute time frame. The dish itself is light and nutritious, with a good balance of fibre and healthy fats. Since you mentioned a liking for potato, you might appreciate the earthy undertones from the sesame seeds, which complement the sweetness of the snow peas. Give it a try!
